user.description:
The user that made the queries. This will usually be the {@link User#email}. When the user's email is not found,
this field will use the {@link User#name}.

totalQueryCount.description: The number of queries made by the user.

lastQueryTime.description: The time when the user made their last query.

title: This type is used to define the structure of a {@link FetchResult} object in {@link Genai.Query.ResultCount#usage}.
name: Genai.Query.ResultCount.Usage
